canonical_title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts
description: Parameter Labs reported a complex attack chain against OpenAI's ChatGPT "artifacts" feature (formerly Canvas, now HTML previews). The feature renders interactive custom HTML apps inside a sandboxed iframe. The researchers found that the sandbox could be bypassed, allowing malicious HTML to interact with OpenAI APIs and gain access to user credentials, effectively taking over ChatGPT accounts.

canonical_title: Memdoor: A team of 5 Qwen3.8-27B models beats Fable 5 on LiveCodeBench Hard
description: The Memdoor project assembled a team of five Qwen3.8-27B language models and used them together to solve coding tasks. In the LiveCodeBench Hard benchmark, this ensemble achieved higher scores than the single Fable 5 model, according to a Hacker News post.

The datasette-llm plugin was updated to version 0.1a9. The update makes the plugin automatically pick up the default model used by the LLM, so Datasette Agent can be started without explicitly configuring a model via the plugins.datasette-agent.de… setting.
